newsitem.title: ITALY: Employment in big Italian firms falls yr/yr in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Employment in big Italian firms falls yr/yr in Oct.

text.p: Employment in Italian industrial firms with more than 500 employees fell 3.5 percent year-on-year in October, the national statistics institute Istat said.
Its employment index for the sector stood at 75.4 (1988=100) in October, with employment down 0.9 percent on September.
In September the index was 2.8 percent down year-on-year and 0.5 percent lower on the previous month.
In the services sector, the employment index stood at 90.1 (1992=100), a fall of 1.3 percent year-on-year and of 0.8 percent on September.
